other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal categorical handling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent converts categorical features to numerical values using OrdinalEncoder and feeds them to gradient boosting models (LightGBM, CatBoost) as continuous variables, failing to leverage the native categorical feature handling capabilities of these libraries.

summary: The agent builds an ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost models using K-Fold cross-validation but completely fails to compute any validation metrics. Additionally, it applies naive equal-weight ensembling, performs no data cleaning or feature engineering, and misses the opportunity to use the native categorical handling capabilities of its chosen models.
